mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS file_upload_task ( id BIGINT AUTO_INCREMENT PRIMARY KEY, upload_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, file_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, upload_type VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, original_name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, object_key VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, part_object_prefix VARCHAR(512), bucket_name VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, content_type VARCHAR(128), file_size BIGINT NOT NULL, file_md5 CHAR(32) NOT NULL, file_ext VARCHAR(32), status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, part_size BIGINT, part_count INT, created_at DATETIME NOT NULL, updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, completed_at DATETIME, UNIQUE KEY uk_file_upload_task_upload_id (upload_id), KEY idx_file_upload_task_owner_status_created_at (owner_id, status, created_at), KEY idx_file_upload_task_status_created_at (status, created_at) ) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4
mapper.select: SELECT id, upload_id, file_id, owner_id, upload_type, original_name, object_key, part_object_prefix, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, status, part_size, part_count, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM file_upload_task WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND upload_id = #{uploadId} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE file_upload_task SET status = 'SUCCESS', updated_at = NOW(), completed_at = NOW() WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND upload_id = #{uploadId} AND status = 'UPLOADING'
UPDATE file_upload_task SET status = 'ABORTED', updated_at = NOW(), completed_at = NOW() WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND upload_id = #{uploadId} AND status = 'UPLOADING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM file_upload_task WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'UPLOADING'
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(file_size), 0) FROM file_upload_task WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND status = 'UPLOADING'

SELECT id, upload_id, file_id, owner_id, upload_type, original_name, object_key, part_object_prefix, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, status, part_size, part_count, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM file_upload_task WHERE status = 'UPLOADING' AND created_at <= #{createdBefore} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, upload_id, file_id, owner_id, upload_type, original_name, object_key, part_object_prefix, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, status, part_size, part_count, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM file_upload_task WHERE id > #{lastId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, upload_id, file_id, owner_id, upload_type, original_name, object_key, part_object_prefix, bucket_name, content_type, file_size, file_md5, file_ext, status, part_size, part_count, created_at, updated_at, completed_at FROM file_upload_task WHERE status = 'UPLOADING' AND id > #{lastId} ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
